verdict.rationale: Whether a cloud platform's source (or its CLI) is published under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says Fly.io, flyctl, or any first-party component is open source or names a license. The AGPL mention refers to a third-party storage project Fly suggests, not Fly's own code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
